question: Should Windows local-only reviews treat a runnable PATH `codex` as the operator-selected default when both PATH and Codex Desktop installations exist?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it intentionally changes a documented default and may switch the executable used by existing Windows installations; only repository owners can accept that compatibility contract.

options.title: Adopt PATH-first precedence
options.body: Merge the current contract so explicit `CODEX_BIN` wins, PATH represents operator selection, and Desktop remains the absence fallback.

options.title: Keep Desktop-first compatibility
options.body: Revise the patch to preserve the existing default and require an explicit environment or configuration opt-in for PATH-first selection.

recommendation.title: Adopt PATH-first precedence
recommendation.body: Merge the current contract so explicit `CODEX_BIN` wins, PATH represents operator selection, and Desktop remains the absence fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice changes the repository's documented Windows local-review default and requires product-level compatibility ownership.
